messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: SEV2 - Multiple 504s for inference-dedicated-prod coming from us-west-2c. Alert PDR-9099.

ben: acked. I'm oncall for infra. pulling the network runbook now.

lina: seeing ~18% 504s from edge -> NLB in us-west-2c, TCP resets and long SYN retries. health checks flapping for tg-infer-usw2c.

chris: metric spike aligns with high EBS IO wait on a subset of instances (i-0c1d2e3f). Could be noisy neighbor or ENI hampering throughput.

ben: checking VPC flow logs, seeing repeated "Destination unreachable" and "ENI status: detached" entries starting 04:10 UTC. tagging net-squad and escalation.

infra-bot: AWS Status: Investigating an issue impacting EC2/SRIOV network connectivity in us-west-2c. (https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/abcd1234)

heidi: Route53 weighted routing currently sends 40% traffic to us-west-2c. Recommend immediate traffic shift to us-west-2a/b and enable failover policy for inference hostnames.

ben: agreed. Lina, please prepare a Route53 change. Chris, can you pre-warm target groups in other AZs and start registering replacement instances?

lina: preparing change batch: `{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"infer.prod.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-2c","Weight":5}}]}` will push weight for us-west-2c to 5. submitting now.

lina: change submitted. change id C-Route-9099. TTLs are low (30s) so propagation should be quick.

chris: spinning up 4 replacements in us-west-2b (c5.4xlarge). registering to tg-infer-usw2b. warming caches and KV.

ben: also enable cross-zone load balancing and increase NLB connection timeout so in-flight requests don't drop while we drain.

heidi: initiated `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:tg:... --attributes Key=stickiness.enabled,Value=false` to reduce uneven stickiness that was keeping traffic on problematic nodes.

ben: start graceful deregister of suspected instances in us-west-2c: i-0c1d2e3f, i-0f4g5h6i. Do not terminate. Drain and keep for forensic logs.

chris: deregistered two targets. connection_drain 300s in progress.

lina: DNS responses now show fewer us-west-2c records. Client-side retries should route to healthy AZs quickly.

support-bot: Posting status: "Partial AZ networking degradation in us-west-2c affecting a subset of inference traffic. Traffic shifted to healthy AZs; mitigation in progress."

ben: opened AWS support case with networking logs and ENI detach traces. case #AWS-2026-2227. Attaching flow logs and instance logs.

infra-bot: PagerDuty note: SEV2 PDR-9099 assigned to ben. Handoff planned in 30m unless cleared.

chris: after shift, 504s dropped from 18% to ~2.5% over 3 mins. Latency back to baseline for the majority of calls. Some long-tail retries still visible.

lina: making a short customer-facing blurb for comms: "We detected increased networking errors impacting a portion of capacity in a single AZ (us-west-2c). We shifted traffic to other availability zones and are working with our cloud provider. Most customers are now seeing normal service."

ben: marking SEV state: mitigated -> watch. Keep this channel active for AWS updates and any rollback sequencing. Lina, can you take the handoff in 30m?

lina: I can. I'll run rollback checklist only once AWS confirms fix for ENI flaps and control-plane stabilization.

heidi: note for postmortem: consider reducing Route53 weight granularity in runbook and add NLB healthcheck frequency increase as an automated mitigation step.

chris: also add an automated alarm for ENI detach rate > X/min to catch early. Current alert threshold was too high.

ben: final checks: confirm EBS IO of the two deregistered instances is saved to logs, create snapshot if needed, and keep instances for AWS review.

lina: created ticket post-incident and scheduled postmortem. I'll include timeline + commands run + AWS case link.

support-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Mitigation in progress — traffic shifted away from us-west-2c. Monitoring for full recovery."

pagerbot: Incident PDR-9099 acknowledged. Watch owner: lina will take over at +30m.

ben: good work everyone. I'll remain available during handoff window. Please add any residual tasks to the incident board. :thumbsup:
